command: f=.claude/skills/service-health/SKILL.md; [ -f "$f" ] && grep -q '^name:' "$f" && grep -q '^description:' "$f" && echo pass || echo fail

description: service-health separates a deterministic collection zone from a reasoning zone and probes /healthz and /readyz
command: f=.claude/skills/service-health/SKILL.md; grep -qi 'deterministic\|collect' "$f" && grep -qi 'reason\|analy' "$f" && grep -q '/healthz' "$f" && grep -q '/readyz' "$f" && echo pass || echo fail

description: service-health declares an output schema and stop conditions
command: f=.claude/skills/service-health/SKILL.md; grep -qi 'output schema\|## output' "$f" && grep -qi 'stop condition' "$f" && echo pass || echo fail
f=.claude/skills/terraform-plan-review/SKILL.md; [ -f "$f" ] && grep -q '^name:' "$f" && grep -q '^description:' "$f" && echo pass || echo fail

description: terraform-plan-review ships a deterministic detection script (progressive disclosure — logic lives in a script, not inline prose)
NEGATIVE test: the detection script flags the stateful-replace fixture (DB destroy+recreate) as a replacement
command: out=$(bash .claude/skills/terraform-plan-review/scripts/detect-replace.sh infra/fixtures/plan-stateful-replace.json 2>/dev/null); echo "$out" | grep -Eq 'replacements=[1-9]' && echo pass || echo fail

description: POSITIVE test: the detection script reports zero replacements on the clean plan-good fixture (no false alarm)
command: out=$(bash .claude/skills/terraform-plan-review/scripts/detect-replace.sh infra/fixtures/plan-good.json 2>/dev/null); echo "$out" | grep -q 'replacements=0' && echo pass || echo fail

description: .claude/skills/k8s-diagnose/SKILL.md exists, collects pod status/events/logs, and stops before mutating
command: f=.claude/skills/k8s-diagnose/SKILL.md; [ -f "$f" ] && grep -q '^name:' "$f" && grep -qi 'kubectl get' "$f" && grep -qi 'describe\|events' "$f" && grep -qi 'stop condition' "$f" && echo pass || echo fail

description: k8s-diagnose is read-only: it must not contain kubectl apply/delete/scale/rollout in its collection zone
command: f=.claude/skills/k8s-diagnose/SKILL.md; grep -Eqi 'kubectl (apply|delete|scale|rollout|edit)' "$f" && echo fail || echo pass

description: .claude/skills/release-check/SKILL.md exists and gates a release on health + tests + clean tree
command: f=.claude/skills/release-check/SKILL.md; [ -f "$f" ] && grep -q '^name:' "$f" && grep -qi 'healthz\|health' "$f" && grep -qi 'test' "$f" && grep -qi 'git status\|uncommitted\|clean' "$f" && echo pass || echo fail

description: .claude/skills/incident-triage/SKILL.md exists, reads an incident ticket, and produces an evidence packet
command: f=.claude/skills/incident-triage/SKILL.md; [ -f "$f" ] && grep -q '^name:' "$f" && grep -qi 'incident' "$f" && grep -qi 'evidence packet\|evidence-packet' "$f" && echo pass || echo fail

description: incident-triage declares stop conditions bounding evidence collection (no unbounded/fix actions)
command: f=.claude/skills/incident-triage/SKILL.md; grep -qi 'stop condition' "$f" && grep -qi 'do not\|report only\|no fix\|bounded' "$f" && echo pass || echo fail

description: a side-effecting skill (service-restart) exists and is marked human-only / not auto-invoked (invisible to automatic invocation)

description: YOUR REBUILD: .claude/skills/service-health/REBUILD-NOTES.md exists — the one artifact this module ships that did not ship with the workspace, since every skill file did

YOUR REBUILD: the notes compare in both directions — what the reference had that yours missed AND something yours does better — because a reference written by someone else is not automatically right about your platform
command: F=.claude/skills/service-health/REBUILD-NOTES.md; [ -f "$F" ] || { echo fail; exit 0; }; grep -qiE 'miss|lack|absent|did not|missing' "$F" && grep -qiE 'better|improve|stronger|clearer' "$F" && echo pass || echo fail
